title: M2 v2 Per-Day Timeline (Embedded)
description: Computed per-day timeline derived from selected slot options + intra_city_routes. NOT a separate file in M2 (lives ephemerally inside the day file's intra_city_routes + the timeline agent's run output). Schema documented for M3 timeline agent + M4 UI contract.

items.description: Ordered list of timeline items: selected slot options interleaved with intra-city travel segments and (on owning_day) inter-city transportation segments.

from_prior_day.description: Read-only header item shown on arrive_day of a red-eye segment. No budget contribution.
